title: GTA 6 Auto Drive and Cinematic Camera Are Must-Try Features
description: Discover why Eurogamer recommends using Auto Drive and Cinematic Camera in GTA 6 to enhance your gameplay experience through Chapters 1 to 3.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Unlocking the Best Views in GTA 6: Auto Drive and Cinematic Camera

As players dive deeper into the massive open world of *GTA 6*, new ways to experience the game are constantly being discovered. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, players who skip out on utilizing the game's Auto Drive and Cinematic Camera features are missing out on some of the absolute best experiences the title has to offer, particularly as they progress through Chapters 1 to 3.

### Taking in the Sights of Leonida

Set in the sprawling, highly detailed state of Leonida, *GTA 6* offers breathtaking environments ranging from dense urban landscapes to sprawling rural vistas. However, traversing such a massive map can sometimes shift the focus from enjoyment to repetitive transit. 

By leveraging the Auto Drive feature, players are given a unique opportunity to sit back and take in the environment. Instead of solely focusing on navigation and road rules, you can observe the intricate life of the game world reacting around you.

### Elevating the Visual Experience with Cinematic Camera

Pairing Auto Drive with the classic Cinematic Camera elevates the gameplay into a truly theatrical experience. The dynamic camera angles, combined with the game's advanced lighting, weather systems, and audio design, evoke the feel of a high-end crime drama.

Whether you are cruising down a coastal highway at sunset or navigating a rain-slicked city street at night, these features allow you to appreciate the sheer craftsmanship poured into the game's world-building during the critical early chapters.

### Editor's Take

Open-world games are often rushed through in pursuit of the next mission marker, but *GTA 6* rewards players who take a moment to pause. Auto Drive and Cinematic Camera aren't just novelty features—they are invitations to slow down and truly absorb the atmosphere of Leonida.
